name: DodoMRR

sources.title: Homepage — 'Database of verified Dodo startup revenues' with live listings and a '+ Add Startup' control

requirements: Extreme niche fit: the database indexes startups whose revenue is verified via Dodo Payments — a product must process payments through Dodo Payments for the listing to be meaningful
'Verified' premise implies connecting payment-provider credentials (read-only API key pattern used by sibling MRR directories)
'+ Add Startup' control exists on the homepage but its target did not render as a static link
preparation: A live product that bills through Dodo Payments
Dodo Payments account access / read-only API key
Product name, URL, and description for the card
workflow: Open https://www.dodomrr.com/ and click '+ Add Startup'
Complete whatever account/provider-connection flow the control opens (JS-driven; not visible to plain fetch)
Verify revenue, then the startup appears as a card in the database
watchFor: Only worth attempting if the product actually uses Dodo Payments — otherwise skip this destination entirely
Site is a small indie directory 'Built by Abhishek' — expect limited traffic and informal review
Paid 'Advertise' slots exist on the homepage — distinguish listing from advertising
Guessed /add path 404s; the add flow is behind the JS button
countsAsLive: The startup appears as a revenue-verified card on the dodomrr.com homepage database
unknowns: Whether listing is free or paid — no pricing page found
Exact verification mechanism (Dodo API key vs OAuth)
Whether non-Dodo-payment startups are accepted at all
